review_state.description: You want AI's speed. Your clients want their data kept safe. How to use AI with client data responsibly — and stay ahead of the rules landing in 2026.
review_state.preview_text: Most founders have stopped asking whether AI can help. They've seen it draft the proposal, summarise the call, sort the inbox. The capability question is settled. What keeps a careful founder up at night now is quieter and harder to answer: when I paste that client's details into a tool, where does it actually go?
